name: Caer Darrow
shortDescription: Caer Darrow, a Classic-era setting in the Ras Frostwhisper research story.
body: This location appears in the Classic quest sequence. The pre-Cataclysm Western Plaguelands island approach, low ruined cottages, grey water, bare trees and the Scholomance manor silhouette. The exact NPC spawn and island layout are not reconstructed. The scene is interpretive; the story-tour marker and theater staging assert no exact geographic coordinates.
